definitions.name: O3C.BDELTA
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 per opening and -1 per closing bracket

definitions.name: O3C.BDEPTH
definitions.body: O3C.BDELTA 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> greatest nesting depth (a closer with nothing open is ignored)

definitions.name: O3C.BPREFIX
definitions.body: G0A.BSCAN [ '#' EQ ] MAP 'O3C.BT' BIND O3C.BT O1A.IDX 1 ADD 0 O3C.BT SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix (0 when none)

solutions.sensor.filled: 'O3C.SV' BIND O3C.SV O3C.SV O1A.PRESENT 0 GET [ G0B.FILLSTEP ] SCAN
solutions.orders.unpriced: G0C.ORDERS [ 'OX' BIND OX 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: G0C.ORDERS [ 'OT' BIND OT 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.messy.title: LOWER G0D.WORDS [ G0B.TITLECASE ] MAP G0A.UNWORDS
